name: Cebu Open 2016

venue.name: [CityMall Consolacion](http://citymall.com.ph)
venue.address: Sta. Lucia Town Square, Brgy. Cansaga, Consolacion, Cebu

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) is Php 200.00 for 1 event only, Php 300.00 for any 3 events, Php 400.00 for any 6 events; Php 500.00 for any 9 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on June 12, 2016 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no walk-in registrations on the day of the event. For more information please visit the official Cebu Open 2016 facebook page.
